about: Kurt HDL6AL two-station 6 in vise: one CAD mesh in 7 solids, no colours, the body welded to its jaws. As Kurt's HDL6 photos show it: the ductile-iron body ground bare all over, Kurt blue only on the recessed band along each side (y +-60.3 mm, where the HDL decal sits); everything above the bed (z 79.4 mm) the machinable aluminium jaws; the screw and pins steel.
reviewed: 2026-11-05: corrected to the real product: body ground bare with a blue side band, from a Kurt HDL6 product photo (was Kurt blue all over); single-sided, wound as the CAD has it: its winding agrees with the CAD's own normals on 100.0% of the area, and re-winding (normals_make_consistent) would turn 39% inward

rules.why: the recessed band along the +y side, between the top rail and the base flange: Kurt blue
the machinable aluminium jaws: everything above the bed
the thin plates on the stations' floors (parts 0, 2)
the lead screw and its hex (part 3)
pins and screws at the handle end (parts 4-6)
